removed_at.comment: When set, this participant has been removed from the conversation (soft-remove).

removed_by_id.comment: The user who removed this participant. NULL if removed_at is not set, or if the actor was hard-deleted.

role.comment: owner = conversation initiator; admin = support staff.

user_id.comment: Registered user participant.

conversation_participants.comment: Registered-user participants in a conversation. Enables multi-party threads.

assigned_at.comment: When this modmail thread was assigned to assigned_moderator_user_id.

assigned_moderator_user_id.comment: The moderator currently assigned to handle a modmail thread. NULL means unassigned.

channel_type.comment: Conversation channel: chat for user and agent chat, direct_message, modmail, or mod_internal.

community_id.comment: The community this modmail thread belongs to. Required when channel_type is modmail.

created_by_id.comment: The registered user who started the conversation. NULL if the creating user was hard-deleted (ON DELETE SET NULL).

last_activity_at.comment: Database time of the latest message, participant or metadata activity; drives direct-message and modmail inbox pagination.

moderation_report_id.comment: The moderation report this internal mod-discussion thread is about. Set when channel_type is mod_internal and the item is a report. Mutually exclusive with post_id for mod_internal threads.

participant_add_policy.comment: Governs who may add participants to a direct_message conversation. owner_only (default): only the creator may add. all_members: any active participant may add.

post_id.comment: Optional post this conversation is about.

resolved_at.comment: When set, the conversation is resolved. Derived status: open = NULL, resolved = set.

resolved_by_id.comment: The user who marked this conversation as resolved.

rss_feed_item_id.comment: Optional RSS feed item this conversation is about.

subject_user_id.comment: The user who is the subject of a modmail thread. Required when channel_type is modmail.

conversations.comment: Threaded conversations that can be associated with a post or RSS feed item.

copyright_notice_submission_id.comment: Notice submission whose automated assessment was refused. One refusal per submission.

reason.comment: First gate the submission failed: a non-post target, unset thresholds, an unrecorded or later switch-on, an erased or suspended claimant, trust or account age below the minimum, or a claimant or poster daily cap.

refused_at.comment: Time the gate refused automatic withholding.

copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals.comment: Sticky record that a signed-in notice failed an automatic-withholding gate, so only a moderator may withhold it. Written once per submission, never retried when a cap later clears, and never dropped: the notice stays in the staff queue.

copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals_pkey ON public.copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals USING btree (id)

uq_copyright_automatic_withholdi_refusal.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_automatic_withholdi_refusals__notice_submission_id ON public.copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals USING btree (copyright_notice_submission_id)

trigger_copyright_automatic_withholding_.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_automatic_withholding_refusals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_copyright_notice_immutable_evidence()

copyright_claimant_misuse_event_shape.definition: CHECK ((((outcome = 'notice_withdrawn'::copyright_claimant_misuse_event_outcomes) AND (copyright_notice_submission_id IS NOT NULL) AND (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id IS NULL) AND (copyright_restriction_id IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'notice_rejected'::copyright_claimant_misuse_event_outcomes) AND (copyright_notice_submission_id IS NULL) AND (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (copyright_restriction_id IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['restriction_reversed_by_counter_notice'::copyright_claimant_misuse_event_outcomes, 'restriction_reversed_by_appeal'::copyright_claimant_misuse_event_outcomes])) AND (copyright_notice_submission_id IS NULL) AND (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id IS NULL) AND (copyright_restriction_id IS NOT NULL))))

copyright_notice_id.comment: Notice this event is evidence about.

copyright_notice_submission_assessment_i.comment: Staff assessment that found the notice not substantially compliant. Set only for notice_rejected, and at most one event per assessment.

copyright_notice_submission_id.comment: Withdrawal submission. Set only for notice_withdrawn, and at most one event per submission.

copyright_restriction_id.comment: Restriction a counter-notice restoration or appeal reversed. Set only for the two reversal outcomes, and at most one event per restriction.

outcome.comment: What happened to the notice or its restriction. Suspension lifts and moderator reversals of a suspended claimant's withholding are not misuse and are never recorded.

recorded_at.comment: Time the decision that created this evidence was made.

copyright_claimant_misuse_events.comment: Append-only ledger of claimant misuse evidence: a notice withdrawn, a notice rejected on staff review, or a restriction reversed by counter-notice restoration or appeal. Recorded whatever the automatic-withholding switch says. The claimant is the notice's claimant_user_id, so erasing that account erases the link and nothing here suspends anyone.

copyright_claimant_misuse_events_copyrig.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_claimant_misuse_events_copyright_restriction_id_key ON public.copyright_claimant_misuse_events USING btree (copyright_restriction_id)

copyright_restriction_id.comment: Automatic restriction that was reversed. At most one marker per restriction.

reversed_at.comment: Time the reversal was decided; the restore delivery that lifts the restriction follows.

copyright_claimant_suspension_reversals.comment: Marks a restriction that was reversed through the ordinary reversal path because its claimant was suspended, so staff can tell it from a moderator's review of the notice. The reviewer on the restriction is the administrator who suspended the claimant. Never evidence of misuse.

copyright_claimant_suspension_reversals_.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_claimant_suspension_reversals_pkey ON public.copyright_claimant_suspension_reversals USING btree (id)

attempt_number.comment: Monotone sequence across retries and replay rounds for this submission.

created_at.comment: Attempt time derived from the UUIDv7 identifier.

error_code.comment: Small failure class or lease_expired marker, never a response body or token.

outcome.comment: Submitted, retryable, permanent, or administrator-replayed outcome.

replayed_by_id.comment: Retained administrator identity, present only on a replay row and never an authorization source.

status_code.comment: HTTP status when known; no response body is stored.

copyright_dsa_statement_submission_attem.comment: Append-only outcome ledger; the rows after the latest replay determine retry budget and dead-letter state.

amazon_ses_message_id.comment: SES provider identifier used to correlate delivery feedback.

body_ciphertext.comment: Immutable encrypted receipt or reply body sent for an email intake, so every retry sends the same legal text; NULL for case deliveries.

bounced_at.comment: Time SES reported a bounce or complaint for an accepted email.

channel.comment: Transport channel used for the delivery.

claimed_at.comment: Time a transport worker most recently claimed the obligation.

copyright_notice_correspondence_message_.comment: Optional private correspondence body delivered by this obligation.

copyright_notice_email_intake_id.comment: Private inbound email this receipt or reply answers; exactly one of this and copyright_notice_id is set, and at most one delivery of each kind exists per intake.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Copyright case that owns the delivery obligation; NULL for a reply to a declined email intake, which never creates a case.

copyright_notice_submission_id.comment: Optional immutable submission that caused the delivery.

delivery_attempt_count.comment: Number of claimed transport attempts, capped to prevent an unhealthy obligation starving other delivery work.

delivery_attempted_at.comment: Time the terminal transport attempt began.

delivery_kind.comment: Legal event communicated by this delivery. staff_information_request emails the notice claimant a staff request for more information and always references its immutable correspondence message.

failed_at.comment: Time the most recent retryable transport attempt failed.

failure_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted bounded transport failure visible to staff; retries retain the failure history through lifecycle events.

idempotency_key.comment: Stable domain key preventing duplicate delivery obligations.

lease_token.comment: Opaque worker ownership token rotated on each claim or reclaim; completion and failure compare it for equality. It identifies no durable row.

next_attempt_at.comment: Earliest retry time after a retryable transport failure; NULL for terminal states.

recipient_role.comment: Legal role of the recipient: claimant, affected poster or setter, informed community owner, or external email correspondent.

recipient_user_erased_at.comment: Time account erasure removed a poster recipient reference while retaining the legal delivery record.

recipient_user_id.comment: Voucha user receiving the notice when the recipient has an account.

sent_at.comment: Time the provider accepted the delivery.

target_path.comment: Immutable community URL selected when an informed-owner obligation is created; delivery does not derive a relationship from the idempotency key.

copyright_notice_delivery_intents.comment: Durable, idempotent legal-notice delivery obligations, including statements of reasons, decision notices, authenticated arrival receipts, and private replies to rejected email intakes. Transport workers claim and transition intents; they cannot alter case facts.

copyright_lifecycle_event_source_shape.definition:
CHECK (((num_nonnulls(copyright_notice_submission_id, copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id, copyright_notice_evidence_artifact_id, copyright_notice_correspondence_id, copyright_notice_legal_hold_assessment_id, copyright_notice_legal_hold_resolution_id, copyright_notice_deadline_id, copyright_restriction_id, copyright_notice_action_intent_id, copyright_notice_email_intake_id, copyright_notice_delivery_intent_id, media_delivery_registry_key, copyright_notice_guest_capability_id) =
CASE
    WHEN (change_type = 'notice_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END) AND
CASE
    WHEN (change_type = 'notice_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN true
    WHEN (change_type = ANY (ARRAY['supplement_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'appeal_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'counter_notice_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'withdrawal_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'court_or_ccb_hold_received'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'appeal_reviewed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'counter_notice_reviewed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types])) THEN (copyright_notice_submission_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'submission_assessed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'evidence_artifact_recorded'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_evidence_artifact_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = ANY (ARRAY['outbound_correspondence_created'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'agent_correspondence_approved'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'email_correspondence_admitted'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types])) THEN (copyright_notice_correspondence_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'legal_hold_assessed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_legal_hold_assessment_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'legal_hold_resolved'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_legal_hold_resolution_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'counter_notice_deadline_started'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_deadline_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = ANY (ARRAY['provisional_restriction_imposed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'mandatory_human_review_completed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'restriction_lifted_by_administrator'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types])) THEN (copyright_restriction_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = ANY (ARRAY['restoration_intent_created'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'reversal_restoration_intent_created'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'copyright_action_replayed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'restoration_unavailable'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'restriction_lifted_placement_retained'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'restoration_authorized_pending_delivery'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'placement_withheld'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'placement_restored'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types])) THEN (copyright_notice_action_intent_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'email_correspondence_rejected'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_email_intake_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'delivery_intent_replayed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (copyright_notice_delivery_intent_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = 'media_delivery_registry_replayed'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types) THEN (media_delivery_registry_key IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN (change_type = ANY (ARRAY['guest_capability_issued'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'guest_capability_revoked'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types, 'guest_capability_revoked_by_withdrawal'::copyright_notice_lifecycle_change_types])) THEN (copyright_notice_guest_capability_id IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE false
END))

id.comment: UUIDv7 identity of the administrator lift.

lifted_at.comment: Time the administrator made the restoration decision.

lifted_by_id.comment: Administrator who made the decision; cleared only for account erasure.

copyright_restriction_administrator_lift.comment: Immutable administrator decisions to restore a restricted image when no live subscriber can respond.

copyright_restriction_administrator_lift.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts_pkey ON public.copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_restriction_administrator_.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts__actor ON public.copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts USING btree (lifted_by_id) WHERE (lifted_by_id IS NOT NULL)

uq_copyright_restriction_administrator_l.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts__restriction_id ON public.copyright_restriction_administrator_lifts USING btree (copyright_restriction_id)

authorizing_assessment_id.comment: Immutable exact compliant assessment that authorized this restriction.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Parent notice scope used by concrete composite foreign keys; populated from the owning parent on insertion.

copyright_notice_target_id.comment: Exact allegation target governed by this independent restriction.

human_review_action.comment: Human outcome for this target restriction: confirm or reverse.

human_reviewed_at.comment: When staff completed the mandatory review of this exact provisional restriction.

human_reviewed_by_id.comment: Staff reviewer; may become NULL only when the reviewer account is erased.

imposed_at.comment: When the independent restriction became active.

imposed_by_id.comment: Staff actor that imposed the restriction, or NULL for an authorized automatic provisional action.

lifted_at.comment: One-way timestamp recording when this restriction was lifted.

lifted_by_id.comment: Staff actor that lifted the restriction; NULL denotes an authorized system restoration.

copyright_restrictions.comment: Independent, reversible legal restrictions; lifting one restriction never lifts another active restriction.

copyright_restrictions_copyright_notice_.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_restrictions_copyright_notice_id_id_key ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (copyright_notice_id, id)

copyright_restrictions_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_restrictions_pkey ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_restrictions__imposed_by.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_restrictions__imposed_by ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (imposed_by_id) WHERE (imposed_by_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_copyright_restrictions__lifted_by.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_restrictions__lifted_by ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (lifted_by_id) WHERE (lifted_by_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_copyright_restrictions__one_active_p.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_copyright_restrictions__one_active_per_target ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (copyright_notice_target_id) WHERE (lifted_at IS NULL)

idx_copyright_restrictions__target.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_restrictions__target ON public.copyright_restrictions USING btree (copyright_notice_target_id)

copyright_restriction_id.comment: The moderator-confirmed restriction this entry belongs to. Lifting the restriction deletes the entry.

image_id.comment: Retained identity of the confirmed image the hashes were taken from, even if its live row is deleted.

perceptual_hash.comment: 64-bit difference hash (dHash) of the image, for near-duplicate matching by Hamming distance. Null until the image worker computes it, or when the image is too flat to hash.

sha_256.comment: SHA-256 of the original image bytes, for exact re-upload matching.

copyright_staydown_entries.comment: Registry of media whose withholding a moderator confirmed, kept only while that restriction is in force. Written only when copyright.staydownMatching is on.

copyright_staydown_entries_copyright_res.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_staydown_entries_copyright_restriction_id_key ON public.copyright_staydown_entries USING btree (copyright_restriction_id)

copyright_staydown_entries_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_staydown_entries_pkey ON public.copyright_staydown_entries USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_staydown_entries__image.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_entries__image ON public.copyright_staydown_entries USING btree (image_id)

idx_copyright_staydown_entries__sha_256.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_entries__sha_256 ON public.copyright_staydown_entries USING btree (sha_256)

trigger_copyright_staydown_entries_updat.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_staydown_entries_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.copyright_staydown_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_update_updated_at()

copyright_staydown_match_reviewer.definition: CHECK (((reviewed_by_id IS NULL) OR (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)))

copyright_staydown_entry_id.comment: The registered image the upload matched; it leads to the case staff review.

hamming_distance.comment: Bit difference between the two perceptual hashes; 0 for an exact match.

image_id.comment: Retained identity of the matching image: the new upload for a perceptual match, or the existing image the upload deduplicated to for an exact match.

match_kind.comment: exact (same SHA-256) or perceptual (dHash within the documented Hamming distance).

reviewed_at.comment: When a moderator marked the match reviewed; null while it waits in the staff queue.

reviewed_by_id.comment: The moderator who reviewed the match; null while unreviewed or once that account is erased.

uploaded_by_id.comment: The user who uploaded the matching bytes.

copyright_staydown_matches.comment: An upload that matched a staydown entry, shown to staff until a moderator marks it reviewed. Never blocks the upload. One row per entry, image and uploader, so a reviewed match is never reopened by a replay. Deleted with its entry when the restriction is lifted.

copyright_staydown_match_unique.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_staydown_match_unique ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (copyright_staydown_entry_id, image_id, uploaded_by_id)

copyright_staydown_matches_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_staydown_matches_pkey ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_staydown_matches__image.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_matches__image ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (image_id)

idx_copyright_staydown_matches__open.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_matches__open ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (copyright_staydown_entry_id) WHERE (reviewed_at IS NULL)

idx_copyright_staydown_matches__reviewed.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_matches__reviewed_by ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (reviewed_by_id) WHERE (reviewed_by_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_copyright_staydown_matches__uploaded.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_staydown_matches__uploaded_by ON public.copyright_staydown_matches USING btree (uploaded_by_id)

trigger_copyright_staydown_matches_updat.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_staydown_matches_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.copyright_staydown_matches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_update_updated_at()

automation_disclosure.comment: How the decision was produced. Constrained to human.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Notice this decision explains. At most one original and one permitted successor per notice.

copyright_notice_submission_assessment_i.comment: Required compliant human assessment for a restrict decision; absent for no_action.

decided_at.comment: When staff recorded the decision (the statement of reasons for eu_dsa).

decided_by_id.comment: Staff user who recorded the decision. Null after that account is deleted.

jurisdiction.comment: Jurisdiction of the notice: eu_dsa or uk. Must equal the notice jurisdiction.

outcome.comment: Human decision: restrict the named targets or take no action.

public_explanation_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted staff-written public explanation for poster and notifier statements; must contain no personal data.

rationale_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted staff-only rationale; never included in participant notices.

supersedes_decision_id.comment: Prior no_action decision reopened by a complaint revoke on the same notice.

copyright_territorial_decisions.comment: Human decision on an EU or UK notice. A revoked no_action can be superseded once by a restrict decision; the live decision is the row without a successor.

copyright_territorial_decisions_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_decisions_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (id)

copyright_territorial_decisions_supersed.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_decisions_supersedes_decision_id_key ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (supersedes_decision_id)

idx_copyright_territorial_decisions__ass.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_decisions__assessment ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id) WHERE (copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_copyright_territorial_decisions__dec.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_decisions__decided_by ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (decided_by_id) WHERE (decided_by_id IS NOT NULL)

uq_copyright_territorial_decisions__noti.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_decisions__notice_id ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (copyright_notice_id, id)

uq_copyright_territorial_decisions__orig.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_decisions__original ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions USING btree (copyright_notice_id, jurisdiction) WHERE (supersedes_decision_id IS NULL)

trigger_copyright_territorial_decisions_.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_decisions_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_decisions_scope BEFORE INSERT ON public.copyright_territorial_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_guard_copyright_territorial_decision()

copyright_eu_supervised_complaint_id.comment: EU supervised complaint that caused this escalation. Exactly one source is set.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Notice this escalation belongs to. The source row must belong to the same notice.

copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgm.comment: Exhausted acknowledgment that caused this escalation. Exactly one source is set.

jurisdiction.comment: Jurisdiction of the notice: eu_dsa or uk. Must equal the notice jurisdiction.

copyright_territorial_escalations.comment: Escalation of one EU or UK notice from either an exhausted acknowledgment or, for EU only, a supervised complaint.

copyright_territorial_escalations_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_escalations_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_territorial_escalations__n.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_escalations__notice ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations USING btree (copyright_notice_id, jurisdiction)

uq_copyright_territoria_escalations__eu_.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territoria_escalations__eu_supervised_complaint_id ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations USING btree (copyright_eu_supervised_complaint_id)

uq_copyright_territorial_escalations__no.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_escalations__notice_acknowledgment_id ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations USING btree (copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgment_id)

trigger_copyright_territorial_escalation.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_escalations_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_escalations_source BEFORE INSERT ON public.copyright_territorial_escalations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_copyright_territorial_escalation()

chk_copyright_territorial_notice_acknowl.definition: CHECK (((acknowledged_at IS NULL) OR (exhausted_at IS NULL)))

acknowledged_at.comment: When acknowledgment succeeded. Mutually exclusive with exhausted_at.

attempt_count.comment: How many acknowledgment attempts have been recorded, from 0 through 5.

copyright_territorial_notice_receipt_id.comment: Receipt this acknowledgment obligation belongs to. One row per receipt.

exhausted_at.comment: When the fifth attempt failed and the obligation was exhausted.

last_attempt_at.comment: When the latest acknowledgment attempt was recorded. Null when attempt_count is 0.

copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgm.comment: Acknowledgment attempts for one EU or UK notice receipt. There is no statutory due time.

copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgm.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments USING btree (id)

uq_copyright_territorial_notice_acknowle.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments__receipt_id ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments USING btree (copyright_territorial_notice_receipt_id)

trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_ack.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments_attempt BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_copyright_territorial_acknowledgment_attempt()

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_acknowledgments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_update_updated_at()

chk_copyright_territorial_notice_receipt.definition: CHECK ((((jurisdiction = 'eu_dsa'::copyright_jurisdictions) AND (notifier_email_ciphertext IS NOT NULL) AND (has_good_faith_statement IS TRUE)) OR ((jurisdiction = 'uk'::copyright_jurisdictions) AND (notifier_email_ciphertext IS NULL) AND (has_good_faith_statement IS NULL))))

copyright_jurisdiction_policy_approval_i.comment: Unwithdrawn policy approval of the same jurisdiction that made this receipt acceptable.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Copyright notice this receipt records. One receipt per notice.

grounds_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted grounds supplied with the notice. The system does not decide merits.

has_good_faith_statement.comment: EU notifier good-faith declaration, required true; absent for UK.

hosted_use_url.comment: URL of the hosted use identified in the notice.

idempotency_key.comment: Caller idempotency key, unique together with requester identity digest and jurisdiction.

jurisdiction.comment: Jurisdiction of the notice and of the policy approval: eu_dsa or uk. Both foreign keys must agree.

notifier_email_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted EU notifier address of record for receipt and later decision notices; absent for UK.

received_at.comment: When Voucha stored this notice receipt.

request_sha256.comment: SHA-256 digest of the received request.

requester_identity_sha256.comment: SHA-256 of the signed-in or guest requester identity, used only to scope idempotency.

requester_user_id.comment: Signed-in requester identity retained after account deletion; null means a genuine guest only. This historical identity never grants authorization.

copyright_territorial_notice_receipts.comment: EU or UK notice receipt. Administrative facts only; no US restoration clock and no merits decision.

copyright_territorial_notice_receipts_pk.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_notice_receipts_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_territorial_notice_receipt.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts__policy ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts USING btree (copyright_jurisdiction_policy_approval_id, jurisdiction)
CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts__requester ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts USING btree (requester_user_id) WHERE (requester_user_id IS NOT NULL)

uq_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts__idempotency ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts USING btree (requester_identity_sha256, jurisdiction, idempotency_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts__notice ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts USING btree (copyright_notice_id, jurisdiction)

trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_rec.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_receipts_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

copyright_territorial_notice_receipt_id.comment: Receipt this routing belongs to. One routing per receipt.

destination.comment: Queue that received the notice. Constrained to staff_queue.

routed_at.comment: When the receipt was routed to the staff queue.

copyright_territorial_notice_routings.comment: Staff-queue routing for one EU or UK notice receipt. Routing is administrative, not a merits decision.

copyright_territorial_notice_routings_pk.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_notice_routings_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_routings USING btree (copyright_territorial_notice_receipt_id)

trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_rou.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_notice_routings_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_notice_routings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

copyright_territorial_redress_request_id.comment: Redress request this decision closes. One decision per request.

decided_at.comment: When staff recorded the redress decision.

decided_by_id.comment: Staff user who recorded the decision. Null after that account is deleted.

rationale_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted staff-supplied rationale for the disposition.

staff_disposition.comment: Staff outcome: maintain or revoke. The system does not choose it.

copyright_territorial_redress_decisions.comment: Staff disposition of one EU or UK redress request. The system does not choose the rationale.

copyright_territorial_redress_decisions_.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_redress_decisions_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_decisions USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_territorial_redress_decisi.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_redress_decisions__decided_by ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_decisions USING btree (decided_by_id) WHERE (decided_by_id IS NOT NULL)

uq_copyright_territorial_redress_decisio.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_redress_decisions__request_id ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_decisions USING btree (copyright_territorial_redress_request_id)

trigger_copyright_territorial_redress_de.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_redress_decisions_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_decisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

chk_copyright_territorial_redress_reques.definition: CHECK (((filed_by = ANY (ARRAY['notifier'::copyright_territorial_party_roles, 'poster'::copyright_territorial_party_roles, 'reviewer'::copyright_territorial_party_roles])) AND ((submitted_by_id IS NOT NULL) OR (filed_by = 'notifier'::copyright_territorial_party_roles))))

copyright_notice_id.comment: Notice this redress request challenges. The composite foreign key requires the cited decision to be on this notice.

copyright_territorial_decision_id.comment: Decision this redress request cites, on the same notice.

explanation_ciphertext.comment: Encrypted explanation supplied by the participant.

filed_by.comment: Role at filing: notifier, target poster, or reviewer. Guest filing can only be notifier.

idempotency_key.comment: Caller idempotency key, unique together with submitted_by_id and jurisdiction.

jurisdiction.comment: Jurisdiction of the notice: eu_dsa or uk. Must equal the notice jurisdiction.

received_at.comment: When Voucha stored this redress request.

submitted_by_id.comment: Retained identity of the submitting account; null only for a guest notifier. Never authorizes a deleted account.

copyright_territorial_redress_requests.comment: Participant redress against one live EU or UK decision. One request per submitter per decision, including one guest request.

copyright_territorial_redress_requests_p.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_territorial_redress_requests_pkey ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_territorial_redress_reques.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__decision ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (copyright_notice_id, copyright_territorial_decision_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__decision_page ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (copyright_territorial_decision_id, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__submitter ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (submitted_by_id) WHERE (submitted_by_id IS NOT NULL)

uq_copyright_territorial_redress_request.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__guest ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (copyright_territorial_decision_id) WHERE (submitted_by_id IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__idempotency ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (submitted_by_id, jurisdiction, idempotency_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_copyright_territorial_redress_requests__party ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests USING btree (copyright_territorial_decision_id, submitted_by_id)

trigger_copyright_territorial_redress_re.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_territorial_redress_requests_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_territorial_redress_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

changed_by_id.comment: Retained identity of the administrator who recorded the transition.

created_at.comment: Transition time derived from the UUIDv7 identifier.

reason.comment: Staff reason for the recorded status transition.

copyright_trusted_flagger_changes.comment: Append-only status transitions; the latest change determines whether a designation is active, suspended or revoked.

copyright_trusted_flagger_changes_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_trusted_flagger_changes_pkey ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_changes USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes__c.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes__changed_by_id ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_changes USING btree (changed_by_id)

idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes__e.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes__entry_id__id ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_changes USING btree (copyright_trusted_flagger_id, id DESC)

trigger_copyright_trusted_flagger_change.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_changes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

trigger_ensure_copyright_trusted_flagger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_ensure_copyright_trusted_flagger_changes_actor BEFORE INSERT ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_changes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ensure_retained_actor_identity('changed_by_id')

copyright_notice_id.comment: EU notice that matched one active designation at receipt time.

copyright_trusted_flagger_id.comment: Designation selected at receipt time, preferring intellectual-property expertise.

created_at.comment: Match time derived from the UUIDv7 identifier.

copyright_trusted_flagger_matches.comment: Immutable match captured when a signed-in linked account files an EU copyright notice; matches are recorded even while priority is off.

copyright_trusted_flagger_matches_copyri.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_trusted_flagger_matches_copyright_notice_id_key ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_matches USING btree (copyright_notice_id)

copyright_trusted_flagger_matches_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_trusted_flagger_matches_pkey ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_matches USING btree (id)

idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_matches__e.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_copyright_trusted_flagger_matches__entry_id ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_matches USING btree (copyright_trusted_flagger_id)

trigger_copyright_trusted_flagger_matche.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_copyright_trusted_flagger_matches_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.copyright_trusted_flagger_matches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation()

area_description.comment: Designation wording for the area of expertise.

area_of_expertise.comment: Closed platform category for the designated expertise; only intellectual_property is in area for copyright notices.

award_reference.comment: Optional published award URL or document identifier.

awarded_on.comment: Date the coordinator awarded the designation.

awarding_coordinator_name.comment: Digital Services Coordinator that awarded the designation.

awarding_member_state.comment: Uppercase two-letter Member State code of the awarding coordinator.

created_at.comment: Creation time derived from the UUIDv7 identifier.

created_by_id.comment: Retained identity of the administrator who recorded this designation; never an authorization source.

name.comment: Entity name as published in the Commission trusted-flagger list.

updated_at.comment: Last database update, including removal of a deleted account link.

user_id.comment: Live signed-in account whose EU notices can match; null after account deletion and never inferred from email.

copyright_trusted_flaggers.comment: Staff-recorded Digital Services Coordinator designation for a trusted flagger. The linked live account is the sole match key; its deletion removes only that link.

copyright_trusted_flaggers_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX copyright_trusted_flaggers_pkey ON public.copyright_trusted_flaggers USING btree (id)

case_id.comment: The moderation case this report belongs to.

reported_user_id.comment: Reported user; set when entity is a user.

reporter_user_id.comment: User who submitted the report. System-generated reports use a dedicated system user (e.g. the ban-evasion system user).

resolution_action.comment: Final moderation report outcome. NULL means pending; application queries derive status from reviewed_at plus this action.

reviewed_at.comment: Timestamp when a moderator reviewed the report.

rss_feed_item_id.comment: Reported RSS feed item; set when entity is rss_feed_item.

moderation_reports.comment: User-submitted reports flagging content or accounts for moderator review. Exactly one entity FK is set per row.

chk_moderation_training_feedbacks__targe.definition: CHECK ((((source_type <> 'prompt_test_run'::moderation_training_source_types) OR (post_id IS NULL)) AND ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['prompt_test_run'::moderation_training_source_types, 'moderation_report'::moderation_training_source_types, 'moderation_appeal'::moderation_training_source_types])) OR (post_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((agent_moderation_id IS NOT NULL) = (source_type = ANY (ARRAY['agent_moderation'::moderation_training_source_types, 'community_prompt'::moderation_training_source_types, 'agent_moderation_vote'::moderation_training_source_types]))) AND ((moderation_report_id IS NOT NULL) = (source_type = 'moderation_report'::moderation_training_source_types)) AND ((moderation_appeal_id IS NOT NULL) = (source_type = 'moderation_appeal'::moderation_training_source_types)) AND ((review_dispute_id IS NOT NULL) = (source_type = 'review_dispute'::moderation_training_source_types)) AND ((post_clearance_change_id IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'community_review'::moderation_training_source_types))))

moderation_training_feedbacks_reason_cod.definition: CHECK (((reason_code IS NULL) OR ((reason_code = TRIM(BOTH FROM reason_code)) AND (char_length(reason_code) <= 120))))

actor_user_id.comment: Human actor who produced the feedback event, if known.

community_id.comment: Community context where the moderation feedback was produced.

event_type.comment: Which human or automated moderation event generated this label.

human_action.comment: Concrete moderator action, e.g. reinstate, keep_removed, approve, reject, dismiss.

input_sha256.comment: Optional SHA-256 digest for the moderated input text.

label.comment: Normalized training label inferred from the human moderation action.

label_confidence.comment: Confidence in the inferred human label; explicit feedback should use 1.

metadata.comment: Structured model outputs, prompt/version references, and export hints.

moderation_appeal_id.comment: Moderation appeal whose resolution produced this feedback.

moderation_report_id.comment: Moderation report whose resolution produced this feedback.

note.comment: Optional moderator note for dataset curation.

post_clearance_change_id.comment: Post clearance state change associated with this feedback.

post_id.comment: Post or comment that the moderation feedback labels.

reason_code.comment: Optional normalized reason chip selected by a moderator.

review_dispute_id.comment: Review dispute whose resolution produced this feedback.

source_type.comment: Which moderation workflow produced the candidate example.

moderation_training_feedbacks.comment: Human moderation feedback events used to build agent training and evaluation datasets.

chk_notifications__delete_reason.definition: CHECK ((((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (delete_reason IS NULL)) OR ((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (delete_reason IS NOT NULL))))

chk_notifications__delivery_sender.definition: CHECK ((((delivery_type = 'subscription'::notification_delivery_types) AND (sent_by_id IS NULL)) OR ((delivery_type = 'manual_send'::notification_delivery_types) AND (sent_by_id IS NOT NULL))))

chk_notifications__entity_columns.definition: CHECK ((((entity_type = 'post'::notification_entity_types) AND (post_id IS NOT NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'rss_feed_item'::notification_entity_types) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['follow'::notification_entity_types, 'referral_signup'::notification_entity_types])) AND (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'moderation_report'::notification_entity_types) AND (moderation_report_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'review_dispute'::notification_entity_types) AND (review_dispute_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'user_warning'::notification_entity_types) AND (user_warning_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'moderation_appeal'::notification_entity_types) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = 'community_ban'::notification_entity_types) AND (community_ban_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type = chk_notifications__target.definition: CHECK ((((entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['community_application_decision'::notification_entity_types, 'community_role_change'::notification_entity_types, 'community_ownership_transfer'::notification_entity_types])) AND (target_path IS NULL) AND (target_intent IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type <> ALL (ARRAY['community_application_decision'::notification_entity_types, 'community_role_change'::notification_entity_types, 'community_ownership_transfer'::notification_entity_types])) AND (num_nonnulls(target_path, target_intent) = 1))))

notifications_copyright_notice_entity_sh.definition: CHECK ((((entity_type = 'copyright_notice'::notification_entity_types) AND (copyright_notice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (post_id IS NULL) AND (rss_feed_item_id IS NULL) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_report_id IS NULL) AND (review_dispute_id IS NULL) AND (user_warning_id IS NULL) AND (moderation_appeal_id IS NULL) AND (community_ban_id IS NULL) AND (conversation_id IS NULL) AND (community_id IS NULL)) OR ((entity_type <> 'copyright_notice'::notification_entity_types) AND (copyright_notice_id IS NULL))))

actor_label.comment: Optional display label for the actor who triggered the notification.

actor_user_id.comment: The user who performed the action triggering this notification. For follow: the follower. For referral_signup: the newly signed-up user (not the referrer). Required for follow and referral_signup types.

community_ban_id.comment: The community ban this notification refers to; set when entity_type is community_ban.

community_id.comment: Community associated with a community lifecycle notification.

conversation_id.comment: The conversation this notification refers to; set when entity_type is direct_message or modmail.

copyright_notice_id.comment: Private copyright case associated with a member notification; the notification body contains no claimant or evidence data.

delete_reason.comment: Why this notification was deleted: system_pruned or user_deleted.

delivery_type.comment: How the notification was triggered: subscription (automatic) or manual_send.

entity_type.comment: The type of entity this notification is about: post, rss_feed_item, follow, referral_signup, moderation_report, review_dispute, or user_warning.

event_key.comment: Stable producer-defined idempotency key, unique per recipient even after dismissal.

moderation_appeal_id.comment: The moderation appeal this notification refers to; set when entity_type is moderation_appeal.

moderation_report_id.comment: Moderation report this notification refers to; set when entity_type is moderation_report.

post_id.comment: The post this notification refers to; set when entity_type is post.

publication_post_id.comment: Stable post target retained after the display FK is cleared by hard deletion. References the retained post identity and does not grant live visibility.

publication_rss_feed_item_id.comment: Stable RSS item target retained after the display FK is cleared by hard deletion. References the retained RSS item identity and does not grant live visibility.

pushed_at.comment: When a push notification was sent for this notification.

read_at.comment: When the user read this notification.

review_dispute_id.comment: The review dispute this notification refers to; set when entity_type is review_dispute.

rss_feed_item_id.comment: The RSS feed item this notification refers to; set when entity_type is rss_feed_item.

sent_by_id.comment: The user who manually sent this notification; set when delivery_type is manual_send.

target_intent.comment: Structured application navigation intent. Community entity targets are derived from community_id instead of a stored document.

target_path.comment: URL path the notification links to. Producers that navigate by path still write this column.

user_id.comment: The user receiving this notification; also the partition key.

user_warning_id.comment: The user warning this notification refers to; set when entity_type is user_warning.

notifications.comment: User notifications for posts and RSS feed items, range-partitioned by user UUIDv7.

oauth_authorization_server_events_check1.definition: CHECK ((((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['consent_approved'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types, 'consent_denied'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types])) AND (authorization_request_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((event_type = 'access_token_revoked'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types) AND (access_token_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['refresh_family_revoked'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types, 'refresh_reuse_detected'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types])) AND (refresh_token_family_id IS NOT NULL))))

oauth_authorization_server_events_check2.definition: CHECK ((((event_type = 'consent_denied'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types) AND (grant_id IS NULL)) OR ((event_type <> 'consent_denied'::oauth_authorization_server_event_types) AND (grant_id IS NOT NULL))))

access_token_id.comment: Short-lived access token affected by a revocation event; intentionally not a foreign key.

authorization_request_id.comment: Short-lived authorization request that produced a consent event; intentionally not a foreign key.

client_id.comment: Client internal identifier at event time; intentionally not a foreign key so client deletion preserves the audit record.

event_type.comment: Immutable consent, explicit revocation, or refresh-reuse lifecycle outcome.

grant_id.comment: Grant internal identifier at event time; intentionally not a foreign key so grant deletion preserves the audit record.

occurred_at.comment: UUIDv7-derived time at which the event was recorded.

refresh_token_family_id.comment: Short-lived refresh family affected by revocation or reuse; intentionally not a foreign key.

resource.comment: Protected resource audience affected by the event.

scopes.comment: Canonical scope set affected by the event.

user_id.comment: Grant owner at event time; references the retained user identity so hard deletion preserves the audit record.

oauth_authorization_server_events.comment: Append-only durable evidence of OAuth consent and token revocation lifecycle events; user_id references the retained user identity, and client, grant, request, and token ids are audit snapshot identifiers without foreign keys, so retention and identity deletion cannot erase the audit record.

oauth_authorizations_check.definition: CHECK ((((purpose = 'authenticate'::oauth_authorization_purposes) AND (initiating_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((purpose = 'connect'::oauth_authorization_purposes) AND (initiating_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

oauth_authorizations_check1.definition: CHECK ((((callback_mode = 'native'::oauth_callback_modes) AND (completion_proof_challenge ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$'::text)) OR ((callback_mode = 'web'::oauth_callback_modes) AND (completion_proof_challenge IS NULL))))

oauth_authorizations_check3.definition: CHECK ((((provider = 'facebook'::oauth_authorization_providers) AND (x_user_id IS NULL) AND (github_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((provider = 'x'::oauth_authorization_providers) AND (facebook_user_id IS NULL) AND (github_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((provider = 'github'::oauth_authorization_providers) AND (facebook_user_id IS NULL) AND (x_user_id IS NULL))))

oauth_authorizations_check4.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['callback_received'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'exchanging'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'completion_ready'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'completed'::oauth_authorization_statuses])) OR (callback_received_at IS NOT NULL)))

oauth_authorizations_check5.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['completion_ready'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'completed'::oauth_authorization_statuses])) OR ((completion_ready_at IS NOT NULL) AND (callback_code_ciphertext IS NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(facebook_user_id, x_user_id, github_user_id) = 1))))

oauth_authorizations_check6.definition: CHECK ((((status <> 'completed'::oauth_authorization_statuses) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (result_kind IS NULL) AND (result_user_id IS NULL) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::oauth_authorization_statuses) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (result_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((result_kind = 'authenticated'::oauth_authorization_result_kinds) AND (result_device_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(result_device_id) = 7) AND (result_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(result_session_id) = 7) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL)) OR ((result_kind = 'mfa_required'::oauth_authorization_result_kinds) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(login_attempt_id) = 7)) OR ((result_kind = 'connected'::oauth_authorization_result_kinds) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL))))))

callback_code_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the one-time provider code; cleared only after durable provider-account persistence.

callback_error.comment: Bounded provider callback or terminal exchange error code; never contains provider credentials.

callback_mode.comment: web uses an HttpOnly completion cookie; native uses a bearer token plus the app-held proof verifier.

callback_received_at.comment: When the provider callback first durably persisted a code or denial.

completed_at.comment: When a caller first consumed and finalized the durable completion result.

completion_proof_challenge.comment: Native-only base64url SHA-256 challenge for the app-held completion verifier.

completion_ready_at.comment: When provider identity persistence completed and the result became consumable.

completion_token_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the completion token retained only so a repeated provider callback converges on the same handoff.

completion_token_hash.comment: Purpose-bound HMAC-SHA256 of the web cookie or native callback bearer token.

exchange_attempts.comment: Durable count of claimed provider exchange attempts for reconciliation and operator diagnosis.

exchange_claim_id.comment: Fencing token for one worker exchange attempt; atomic provider-account completion must present the current claim.

exchange_started_at.comment: When the current fenced provider exchange claim began.

expires_at.comment: Authorization deadline; cleanup and recovery use this timestamp rather than UUID ordering.

facebook_user_id.comment: Facebook account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

github_user_id.comment: GitHub account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

initiating_device_id.comment: Device JWT identifier that must still match when completion is consumed.

initiating_session_id.comment: Session JWT identifier that must still match when completion is consumed.

initiating_user_id.comment: Required owner for connect flows and NULL for authenticate flows.

login_attempt_id.comment: UUIDv7 MFA attempt identifier returned only for an mfa_required result.

pkce_verifier_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the server-generated provider PKCE verifier.

provider.comment: Provider selected at begin time; callback and completion derive it only from this durable record.

purpose.comment: authenticate creates or resumes a Voucha session; connect links the provider account to the authenticated initiating user.

redirect_uri.comment: Server-selected public provider callback URI; callers cannot supply or override it.

result_device_id.comment: Authenticated result device UUIDv7 allocated while the completion row is locked and reused by every issuance or replay.

result_kind.comment: Durable completion outcome: authenticated, MFA required, or connected.

result_session_id.comment: Authenticated result session UUIDv7 allocated while the completion row is locked and reused by every issuance or replay.

result_user_id.comment: Voucha user receiving the completion result; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

state_hash.comment: Purpose-bound HMAC-SHA256 of the provider state; plaintext state is returned once and never persisted.

status.comment: Explicit lifecycle: pending, callback_received, exchanging, completion_ready, completed, rejected, or expired.

x_user_id.comment: X account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

oauth_authorizations.comment: Durable server-begun OAuth state machine shared by web and native Facebook, X, and GitHub authentication and account connection.

idx_oauth_authorizations__active_web_aut.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_oauth_authorizations__active_web_authentication ON public.oauth_authorizations USING btree (initiating_device_id, initiating_session_id) WHERE ((callback_mode = 'web'::oauth_callback_modes) AND (purpose = 'authenticate'::oauth_authorization_purposes) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'callback_received'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'exchanging'::oauth_authorization_statuses, 'completion_ready'::oauth_authorization_statuses])))

oauth_clients_check.definition: CHECK ((((client_type = 'public'::oauth_client_types) AND (token_endpoint_auth_method = 'none'::oauth_client_token_endpoint_auth_methods) AND (client_secret_hash IS NULL)) OR ((client_type = 'confidential'::oauth_client_types) AND (token_endpoint_auth_method = 'client_secret_basic'::oauth_client_token_endpoint_auth_methods) AND (client_secret_hash IS NOT NULL))))

oauth_clients_check1.definition: CHECK ((((metadata_url IS NULL) AND (metadata_refresh_generation IS NULL) AND (metadata_refreshed_at IS NULL) AND (metadata_expires_at IS NULL) AND (client_id ~ '^voucha_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}$'::text)) OR ((metadata_url IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id = metadata_url) AND (metadata_refresh_generation IS NOT NULL) AND (metadata_refreshed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (metadata_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (owner_user_id IS NULL) AND (client_type = 'public'::oauth_client_types) AND (token_endpoint_auth_method = 'none'::oauth_client_token_endpoint_auth_methods) AND (client_secret_hash IS NULL) AND (verified_at IS NULL) AND (verified_by_id IS NULL))))

oauth_clients_metadata_url_check.definition: CHECK (((metadata_url IS NULL) OR ((char_length(metadata_url) <= 2048) AND (metadata_url ~* '^https://[^/?#@[:space:][:cntrl:]]+/[^#[:space:][:cntrl:]]*$'::text) AND (POSITION((chr(92)) IN (metadata_url)) = 0) AND (split_part(metadata_url, '?'::text, 1) !~ '/\.\.?(/|$)'::text))))

oauth_clients_verified_by_id_check.definition: CHECK (((verified_by_id IS NULL) OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL)))

client_id.comment: Public OAuth client identifier issued at registration or the exact Client ID Metadata Document URL.

client_name.comment: Display-safe client name shown during consent.

client_secret_hash.comment: Purpose-bound hash of a one-time confidential client secret.

client_type.comment: Public or confidential OAuth client classification.

actor_user_id.comment: Authenticated actor that owns the idempotency key and its replay record.

expires_at.comment: Replay expiration for committed admission records.

age_threshold_days.comment: Days after which a successful crawl is considered stale and should be re-crawled.

attempt_threshold_hours.comment: Hours to wait before retrying a failed crawl.

consecutive_dns_failures.comment: Number of consecutive DNS lookup failures for this hostname. Resets to 0 on any successful crawl. Resets to 1 (not incremented) when last_dns_failure_at is older than 7 days.

dns_disabled_at.comment: When this hostname was automatically disabled due to repeated DNS failures. NULL if not auto-disabled. Clearing this (and resetting crawlable) is an admin-only action.

is_blocked.comment: Whether this hostname is blocked from being used on the site (e.g. spam). Trigger-maintained from url_hostname_blocks — do not write directly in app code.

is_crawlable.comment: Whether pages on this hostname can be crawled.

is_emailable.comment: Whether email addresses at this hostname are accepted.

last_dns_failure_at.comment: When the most recent DNS lookup failure occurred for this hostname.

requests_per_second_limit.comment: Max crawl requests per second for this hostname.

reversed_hostname.comment: Hostname labels reversed (e.g. com.example.www) for efficient subdomain prefix scans.

should_follow_link_rel.comment: If TRUE, links to this hostname use rel=follow. Only for trusted sites.

should_ignore_robots_txt.comment: Whether robots.txt allow/disallow rules are ignored for RSS feed fetches on this hostname. NULL = inherit from global DynamicConfig. TRUE = always ignore. FALSE = always enforce.

should_skip_web_risk.comment: Whether Google Web Risk checks are skipped for this hostname and subdomains.

topic_id.comment: The topic that owns this hostname (primary or additional domain). Many hostnames may share the same topic_id; the primary is identified by topics.hostname_id.

unreliable_status_codes.comment: RSS feed fetch HTTP status codes that should retry instead of soft-deleting feeds for this hostname. NULL = no hostname override. Example: ARRAY[404] for unreliable YouTube feeds.

votes_snapshot_xip_count.comment: Number of transactions still in progress in that vote-stat snapshot; lower is newer when the snapshot xmax is equal.

votes_snapshot_xmax.comment: Upper transaction-ID boundary of the PostgreSQL snapshot used for the persisted vote-stat aggregate.

web_risk_checked_url.comment: URL that produced the Google Web Risk positive verdict for this hostname.

web_risk_expire_at.comment: Google Web Risk expireTime for the positive verdict.

web_risk_threat_types.comment: Google Web Risk threat types returned for the checked URL.

url_hostnames.comment: Registered hostnames with crawl and moderation policies.

completed_at.comment: When the worker uploaded the export to S3.

dispatched_at.comment: When the current processing attempt was most recently enqueued.

expires_at.comment: When the download link expires; the cleanup sweep reclaims the ZIP from S3 after this time.

last_error_message.comment: Most recent bounded processing error retained for audit and recovery.

processing_attempt_id.comment: Durable token fencing one export generation attempt from stale workers.

processing_started_at.comment: When the worker began generating the export.

s3_key.comment: S3 path to the generated ZIP file while the export is downloadable; cleared when reclaimed.

user_id.comment: The subject: the user whose data is exported.

user_data_requests.comment: Tracks user data export requests with lifecycle from queued through download or expiration. Status is derived from timestamp columns.

completed_at.comment: When the create finished and its response was stored; null while the create is still running.

idempotency_key.comment: Caller-supplied UUID identifying one exact create request for this credential owner.

intent_sha256.comment: SHA-256 of the canonical tool name and arguments; reusing the key with a different request is rejected.

lease_token.comment: Opaque fencing token rotated on each claim and takeover; completion and release compare it for equality, so a holder whose lease was taken over can neither finish nor free the newer holder's claim. It identifies no durable row.

response.comment: Exact structured result the completed create returned, replayed on every retry of the same key and request.

user_id.comment: Credential owner who supplied this idempotency key; the replay is visible only to them.

user_mcp_create_attempts.comment: Actor-owned exact response replays for the delegated MCP create tools that have no post to bind to (community, report, dispute, appeal and community application). One row per credential owner and idempotency key; the row stays so a retry of a completed create keeps returning the first result.

score_is_semantic.comment: Explicit semantic ballot provenance.

session_id.comment: Opaque client session token with no durable owner row.

user_agent_string_id.comment: Shared bounded user-agent string captured with the ballot event.

issued_by_id.comment: The moderator or admin who issued this warning.

public_message.comment: Optional public message shown to the warned user.

reason.comment: Internal reason for the warning (staff-visible only).

report_id.comment: The moderation report that triggered this warning, if any.

revoked_at.comment: When this warning was revoked (e.g. via appeal acceptance). NULL means the warning is still active.

revoked_by_id.comment: The staff user who revoked this warning.

user_id.comment: The user who received this warning.

user_warnings.comment: Records of formal warnings issued to users by moderators or admins.

bad_faith_reporter_at.comment: Set when the user has an active report-abuse penalty; cleared when all penalties are revoked. Used by computeTrustTier to lower trust tier.

cards_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's cards.

community_memberships_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's community memberships.

country.comment: User preferred country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., US).

default_post_broadcast.comment: Default audience setting for new posts.

default_post_privacy.comment: Default privacy setting for new posts.

direct_messages_audience.comment: Privacy: who can send this user direct messages.

followers_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's followers.

follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see who this user follows (user follows).

individual_id.comment: The real-person individual linked to this user account for personal finance tracking.

is_engagement_emails_enabled.comment: Whether the user receives engagement recommendation emails.

is_fediverse_federation_enabled.comment: Per-user opt-in to ActivityPub federation (Phase C). Default FALSE; when TRUE, a public AP actor is exposed at /ap/users/:id and inbound follows are auto-accepted.

is_moderation_emails_enabled.comment: Whether the user receives community moderation summary emails.

is_verified_badge_visible.comment: Whether to display the ID-verified badge on this user's public profile.

likes_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's likes.

markdown.comment: User profile bio in markdown format.

moderation_email_cadence.comment: Cadence for community moderation summary emails.

moderation_email_days_of_week.comment: Days of week for selected-day moderation email cadence, 1=Monday and 7=Sunday.

moderation_email_time_of_day.comment: Local HH:MM time for moderation summary emails.

moderation_email_timezone.comment: IANA timezone for moderation summary email scheduling.

news_digest_frequency.comment: Frequency for first-party news digest emails.

pending_checkout_session_id.comment: Stripe Checkout Session that initiated the current identity-verification flow. Set when transitioning to identity_pending; cleared on terminal state. Used to recover checkout linkage when Stripe redacts VerificationSession metadata.

pending_verification_session_id.comment: Stores the Stripe Checkout Session ID during payment_pending, then the Stripe Identity VerificationSession ID during identity_pending; cleared on terminal state.

platform_account_kind.comment: Reserved platform identity: official for people, system for automation, NULL for members and the deleted tombstone.

processing_restricted_at.comment: When data processing was restricted for this user (GDPR right to restrict processing). NULL means no restriction.

profile_image_id.comment: The user's profile image. NULL if no profile image is set.

public_verified_name_display.comment: How much of the legal name to show publicly.

referrer_user_id.comment: The user who referred this user, for referral attribution.

rewards_program_statuses_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's rewards program statuses.

rss_feed_follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's RSS feed follows.

should_import_hacker_news_discussions.comment: Whether this user opts in to Hacker News discussion imports.

should_receive_third_party_marketing.comment: Marketing opt-in/out: TRUE=opted in, FALSE=opted out, NULL=not set.

spending_categories_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's spending categories.

topic_follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's topic follows.

ui_locale.comment: User preferred UI locale from supported UI message catalogs (e.g., en).

use_display_name_from.comment: Which source to use for the displayed name (username, facebook, x, etc.).

username.comment: Unique username chosen by the user. NULL if not yet set. Case-insensitive (stored lowercase).

verification_completed_at.comment: Timestamp when verification reached a terminal state (verified, failed, or duplicate_id).

verification_provider.comment: Provider used for verification, set once payment is initiated.

verification_status.comment: Current lifecycle state of the user's identity verification.

verified_first_name.comment: Verified legal first name, private unless user opts in.

verified_full_name.comment: Verified legal full name, private unless user opts in.

verified_last_name_initial.comment: Single initial of verified last name, private unless user opts in.

vote_weight.comment: Admin-set multiplier for this user's votes. Default 1.

vote_weight_admin_set_at.comment: When an admin last manually overrode this user's vote weight. NULL if never overridden.

vote_weight_recalculated_at.comment: When the vote weight was last recalculated automatically. NULL if never recalculated.

votes_snapshot_xip_count.comment: Number of transactions still in progress in that vote-stat snapshot; lower is newer when the snapshot xmax is equal.

votes_snapshot_xmax.comment: Upper transaction-ID boundary of the PostgreSQL snapshot used for the persisted vote-stat aggregate.

users.comment: User accounts. Core identity table for all registered users.
